job.title: Consultant(e) en Stratégie & Performance @ STEP Consulting (Toulouse, Occitanie, France)
job.description:
STEP est un cabinet indépendant de conseil en stratégie et performance industrielle. Depuis près de 20 ans, nous nous sommes développés auprès de grands industriels de l’Aéronautique, des Énergies, de l’Automobile et de différentes industries de pointe. Nous sommes environ 60 consultants et data scientists entre Paris, Toulouse et Grenoble.

Faire du conseil chez STEP c’est :

• aller au contact de top managers industriels

• convaincre les clients par des approches analytiques sur des sujets complexes

• croiser des problématiques industrielles, commerciales et financières pour avoir de l'impact sur des projets stratégiques

• construire son parcours professionnel dans un environnement à taille humaine, stimulant et favorisant l’initiative

Nous recherchons des consultant(e)s pour nos bureaux de Paris et Toulouse :

• issu(e)s d’une grande école d’ingénieurs (X, ParisTech, Centrale, ISAE,...) ou de commerce (HEC, ESSEC, ESCP, EM Lyon...)

• aimant travailler en autonomie, en français ou en anglais

• mobile pour aller au contact des clients industriels

• entre 0 et 10 ans d’expérience dans l’industrie et / ou au sein d'un cabinet de conseil

Au quotidien, les équipes de STEP :

• construisent des analyses détaillées pour identifier les vrais besoins des clients

• définissent la stratégie opérationnelle des entreprises et conduisent leur mise en œuvre

• participent au développement commercial de STEP en prenant part aux appels d’offres

• contribuent activement à la vie interne du cabinet (réunions d’équipe, team events, formations,…)

job.title: Chief of Staff – Strategy, Product & Operations (CDI) @ INCOM (Paris, Île-de-France, France)
job.description:
**Chief of Staff – Strategy, Product & Operations (CDI)**

Paris · CDI · Démarrage dès que possible

**À propos du poste**

INCOM transforme l’emploi des chauffeurs VTC en leur offrant sécurité, stabilité et liberté via un modèle salarial innovant.

Pour accompagner notre croissance et le développement de nouveaux projets stratégiques, nous recherchons un(e) Chief of Staff capable de travailler directement avec les fondateurs sur des sujets business, produit, tech et opérationnels.

**Ta mission ? Transformer des opportunités stratégiques en projets concrets, puis en activités performantes et scalables.**

En tant que Chief of Staff, tu interviens de manière transverse sur les projets prioritaires d’INCOM : développement de nouvelles activités, stratégie commerciale, conception produit, opérations, partenariats et pilotage de la performance.

Tu ne seras pas uniquement dans l’analyse ou la coordination : tu devras aussi exécuter, tester, vendre, construire et faire avancer les projets sur le terrain.

Tu es entrepreneurial(e), analytique, orienté(e) résultats, avec une première expérience en startup ou en gestion de projets, et tu veux prendre rapidement des responsabilités ? Ce poste est pour toi.

**Missions**

* **Stratégie & Business Development :**
  identifier de nouvelles opportunités, analyser les marchés, construire des business cases et participer au lancement de nouvelles activités.
* **Sales & Partenariats :**
  prospecter, négocier et signer des premiers clients ou partenaires stratégiques pour développer les projets d’INCOM.
* **Product Management :**
  concevoir les parcours utilisateurs, rédiger les spécifications fonctionnelles et prioriser les fonctionnalités à développer.
* **Tech & Développement :**
  collaborer avec les équipes techniques pour piloter les développements, tester les fonctionnalités et accélérer les mises en production.
* **Operations :**
  structurer et améliorer les processus opérationnels, résoudre les problèmes terrain et garantir la qualité d’exécution.
* **Finance & Performance :**
  construire des modèles financiers, analyser les unit economics et suivre les KPI de croissance, de rentabilité et de performance.
* **Gestion de projets stratégiques :**
  piloter des projets transverses de bout en bout, de leur conception jusqu’à leur déploiement.
* **Collaboration avec les fondateurs :**
  participer aux réflexions stratégiques, préparer les décisions et assurer l’exécution des priorités de l’entreprise.

**Objectif du poste**

Construire et développer de nouvelles activités, de l’idée à l’exécution.

L’objectif est simple :
**transformer les ambitions stratégiques d’INCOM en résultats concrets : nouveaux clients, produits lancés, partenariats signés, opérations structurées et croissance mesurable.**

Tu travailleras sur des projets à différents stades de maturité, avec une forte autonomie et une responsabilité croissante sur leur développement.

**Profil recherché**

* 2 à 5 ans d’expérience en startup, scale-up, entrepreneuriat, conseil en stratégie, Business Operations, Product Management ou Business Development.
* Forte mentalité entrepreneuriale, avec une envie de construire et de prendre des responsabilités.
* Excellentes capacités analytiques et bonne maîtrise des enjeux financiers et business.
* Solide compréhension des produits digitaux et des environnements technologiques.
* Appétence commerciale et capacité à prospecter, négocier et convaincre.
* Capacité à piloter plusieurs projets simultanément et à travailler avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires.
* Très bonne organisation, rigueur et sens des priorités.
* Forte autonomie, capacité d’exécution et orientation résultats.
* À l’aise avec les outils digitaux, l’analyse de données et l’intelligence artificielle.
* Excellent relationnel et capacité à interagir avec des interlocuteurs variés.
* Français courant et anglais professionnel.

**Ce qui fera la différence :**

Tu as déjà lancé un projet entrepreneurial, construit un produit, développé une activité commerciale ou pris la responsabilité d’un projet de zéro à son exécution.

Tu sais passer d’un business plan à un rendez-vous client, d’une analyse de données à une décision produit, et d’une idée à sa mise en œuvre.

**Tu as une mentalité de fondateur : tu prends les sujets en main, tu trouves des solutions et tu fais avancer les choses.**

**Pourquoi rejoindre INCOM ?**

* **Un rôle entrepreneurial :**
  travailler sur des projets stratégiques et participer directement à la création de nouvelles activités.
* **Une forte proximité avec les fondateurs :**
  contribuer aux décisions et à leur exécution.
* **Une exposition transverse :**
  stratégie, sales, produit, tech, finance et opérations.
* **De vraies responsabilités :**
  piloter des projets de bout en bout avec une autonomie importante.
* **Une courbe d’apprentissage rapide :**
  développer une vision complète du fonctionnement et de la croissance d’une entreprise.
* **Un impact mesurable :**
  voir directement les résultats de tes décisions et de ton travail.
* **De fortes perspectives d’évolution :**
  possibilité de prendre progressivement la direction d’un projet, d’une business unit ou d’une nouvelle activité.
* **Un environnement entrepreneurial :**
  rejoindre une équipe ambitieuse qui valorise l’initiative, l’exécution et les résultats.
* **Des bureaux à Station F**
  , au cœur de l’écosystème startup parisien.

**Informations pratiques**

* Type de contrat : CDI
* Localisation : Paris (Station F)
* Rémunération : fixe selon profil + variable lié à la performance
* Date de début : dès que possible
* Reporting : directement aux fondateurs

**À propos d’INCOM**

INCOM est une startup tech & sociale qui transforme le statut des chauffeurs VTC en leur proposant un CDI indépendant : la sécurité d’un emploi salarié, avec la liberté de choisir leurs courses, plateformes et horaires.

Nous nous appuyons sur une communauté engagée de plus de 12 000 chauffeurs qualifiés, prête à rejoindre un modèle plus juste, plus stable et plus protecteur.

Notre mission : devenir le plus grand employeur de chauffeurs VTC en Europe, tout en garantissant de meilleurs revenus, une protection sociale complète et une gestion simplifiée.

job.title: Tok Pasifika Project Adviser @ Pacific Community (Nouméa, DTM, FR)
job.description:
**Description**

The **Pacific Community (SPC)** is the principal scientific and technical organisation in the Pacific region, supporting development since 1947. We are an international development organisation owned and governed by our 27 country and territory members. In pursuit of sustainable development to benefit Pacific peoples, our organisation works across more than 25 sectors. We are known for our knowledge and innovation in such areas as fisheries science, public health, geoscience, and conservation of plant genetic resources for food and agriculture.

The **Operations and Integration (O&I)** collective delivers essential enabling services that support the organisation’s scientific and technical portfolio. Our key functions include corporate services, programme support, partnerships, resource mobilisation, and strategic engagement. These services are coordinated through our regional and satellite offices across the Pacific and Europe. Additionally, the O&I collective leads a dedicated workstream focused on organisational change and transformation to drive continuous improvement and adaptability.

The **Tok Pasifika Project Advisor** is responsible for the implementation, coordination and development of the Tok Pasifika project. This position works to improve the accessibility, quality and impact of Pacific language services, by enhancing the project’s visibility, strengthening and assisting the network of language service providers, supporting integration of language issues into SPC practices, and ensuring monitoring, evaluation and learning as part of the project. The Project Advisor serves as Tok Pasifika’s point of contact with internal teams and external partners, using an inclusive, culturally appropriate approach that is aligned with the SPC’s institutional priorities.

The key responsibilities of the role include the following:

**Improving the Tok Pasifika project’s visibility and outreach**

* Develop a communication plan in collaboration with SPC’s Strategic Communications, Outreach, Publishing and Engagement (SCOPE) team, that takes into account stakeholders’ feedback; and update this plan annually.
* In collaboration with SPC teams, enhance use of existing communication materials and plan and coordinate production of new materials, as needed.
* Create a strong visual identity for the project, and regularly update and track project visibility tools such as the website, intranet page, etc.
* Develop and implement awareness-raising activities for SPC’s technical divisions and other external stakeholders.
* Use the information gathered through Tok Pasifika’s monitoring and evaluation system, take part in efforts to present SPC’s results in a view to raising the profile of Tok Pasifika’s work and results (e.g. drafting performance stories, communicating numerical outcomes).
* Participate in internal, local and/or international cultural events to represent and promote Tok Pasifika.
* Liaise with media outlets to publicise the Tok Pasifika project.

**Building the network of language service providers and improving the quality of the services provided**

* Manage contracts and external contractors, in particular by monitoring and updating the list of preferred service providers (contracts, deadlines, administrative compliance), in collaboration with the Procurement and Finance teams, and ensure that contractual documents are properly filed and accessible.
* Provide support and advice to SPC teams on managing requests for translation into Pacific languages.
* Engage the network on a regular basis (e.g. mailing list, newsletter, focus groups).
* Take part in drafting guidelines for providers and/or organise training sessions (e.g. webinars on translation techniques or administrative procedures, liaison interpreting workshops, etc.), in collaboration with members of the Conference and Languages unit.
* Hold annual meetings (face-to-face or on-line) with language service providers to discuss their needs, difficulties and successes.
* Set up and monitor a system for evaluating the performance of language service providers and their use by SPC teams, with a view to continuously improving the quality, relevance and effectiveness of the language services provided.

**Integrating language issues across SPC and boosting demand**

* Set up and facilitate a Tok Pasifika community of practice in order to strengthen internal coordination, information sharing and ownership of language services within SPC.
* Set up, in collaboration with a focal point within one SPC division, a pilot Pacific language translation project, and identify lessons from that project, in a view to providing better advice to teams and optimising their use of Tok Pasifika services
* Contribute to the integration of language issues from the project design stage, especially in terms of the key forms used, through the relationships established with various relevant SPC teams (SPL, PIRMO, HRSD, Procurement).
* Contribute to the development, adoption and dissemination of an SPC-wide language policy that explicitly recognises the value of Pacific languages and implements the guiding principles for their gradual integration into SPC activities.

**Mobilising project resources and ensuring their sustainability**

* Develop strategic partnerships with institutions, NGOs, universities or companies in the language sector.
* Assist in securing additional funding (grants, partnerships, regional/international calls for projects).
* Optimise existing resources (pooling with other projects, using tools that have already been developed).
* Ensure thorough budget monitoring for the Tok Pasifika project and produce regular financial reports to demonstrate the efficient use of resources and the actual results achieved.

**Monitoring, evaluation and learning**

* Identify and map the Tok Pasifika project’s key internal and external stakeholders and keep this list up to date.
* Undertake an internal assessment, by analysing Pacific language translation needs and carrying out surveys and interviews with the user divisions; and issue a comparison with the previous assessment.
* The approaches to conduct an external assessment are defined (analysis of the needs of SPC stakeholders).
* Develop, implement and refine a framework of indicators to monitor activities, service provider performance, service quality, demand and use of Tok Pasifika services.
* Produce regular monitoring, evaluation and learning reports and use the results and lessons learned to adjust the services Tok Pasifika proposes, as well as the project’s work approaches and communication strategy.
* Draft a project sustainability plan, to be updated annually, which contains the key points, possible project directions and recommendations for integrating multilingualism throughout SPC.

For a more detailed account of the key responsibilities, please refer to the **online job description**.

**Key selection criteria**

**Qualifications**

* A postgraduate qualification in project management; Pacific languages, linguistics or cultures; international relations; cultural studies; or a related field, or equivalent body of knowledge and experience.

**Technical expertise**

* At least 10 years in the management of language-related, cultural or international cooperation projects, ideally in a regional or international institutional context
* Demonstrated project management skills and proficiency in project management methods and tools (planning, monitoring, reporting, coordination and partnerships)
* Experience in purchasing processes in private or public entities
* Experience in administrative and budgetary project management, funding-raising and project monitoring and evaluation

**Language skills**

* Excellent English communications skills
* Proficiency in one or more Pacific languages.

**Interpersonal skills and cultural awareness**

* Very good knowledge of Pacific context and cultures
* Interpersonal skills and cultural awareness

**Salary, terms and conditions**

**Contract Duration** – This vacant position is budgeted for 3 years and is subject to renewal depending on funding and performance.

**Remuneration –** The **Tok Pasifika Project Adviser** is a band 10 position in SPC’s 2026 salary scale, with a starting salary range of SDR (special drawing rights) 3727 to 4562 per month, which converts to approximately XPF 537,766 to 658,322 (USD 4994 to 6114; EUR 4506 to 5517). SPC salaries are not presently subject to income tax in New Caledonia. An offer of appointment for an initial contract will normally be made in the lower half of this range, with due consideration being given to experience and qualifications. Progression within the salary scale is based on annual performance reviews.

**Benefits for international staff employees based in New Caledonia** – SPC provides subsidised housing in Noumea. Establishment and repatriation grant, removal expenses, airfares, home leave travel, health and life and disability insurances and education allowances are available for eligible employees and their eligible dependents. Employees are entitled to 25 working days of annual leave per annum and other types of leave, and access to SPC’s Provident Fund (contributing 8% of salary, to which SPC adds a 10% contribution).

**Languages** – SPC’s working languages are English and French.

**Recruitment principles** – SPC’s recruitment is based on merit and fairness, and candidates are competing in a selection process that is fair, transparent and non-discriminatory. SPC is an **equal-opportunity employer**, and is committed to cultural and gender diversity, including bilingualism, and will seek to attract and appoint candidates who respect these values. Due attention is given to gender equity and the maintenance of strong representation from Pacific Island professionals. If two interviewed candidates are ranked equal by the selection panel, preference will be given to the Pacific Islander. Applicants will be assured of complete confidentiality in line with SPC’s Privacy Policy

**Application procedure**

**Closing date:** 17 January 2027 – 11:00 p.m. (Noumea time)

**Job Reference:** KK000142

Applicants must apply online at: https://careers.spc.int/

Hard copies of applications will not be accepted.

For your application to be considered, you must provide us with:

* an updated resume with contact details for three professional referees
* a cover letter detailing your skills, experience and interest in this position
* responses to all screening questions.

Your application will be considered incomplete and will not be reviewed at shortlisting stage if all the above documents are not provided. Applicants should not attach copies of qualifications or letters of reference

Please ensure your documents are in Microsoft Word or Adobe PDF format.

SPC does not charge a fee to consider your application and will never ask for your banking or financial information during the recruitment process.

**Screening questions (maximum of 2000 characters per question):**

* Please give an example of a project in the area of Pacific Island languages or cultures that you implemented end to end, preferably in an institutional context. What challenges did you face and how did you overcome them?
* Have you ever managed or coordinated a network of external service providers and/or community of practice in a private or public establishment? What were your main responsibilities (contracts, quality, facilitation, monitoring)?
* Can you give an example of a mechanism or tool that you set up to monitor and evaluate a language or cultural project? What arrangements did you make, how did you do that, and what did you learn from that experience?

job.title: Project Leader, Transformation & Value Creation @ Boston Consulting Group (Paris, A8, FR)
job.description:
Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

**Practice Area**

Business Transformation is essential to adapt to ever-changing conditions—even for companies that are already dominating their markets. It’s a big challenge, but BCG’s business transformation consultants can help clients put the odds in their favor. BCG helps companies orchestrate an effective business transformation and turnaround when all signs point to the need for fast, focused action and when companies are grappling with an urgent need to change amid great disruption. We deliver immediate impact to each client’s bottom line, cash flow, and top-line growth—all while concentrating on what the client must do to sustain successful change far into the future. In addition, our special situation services help companies focus on managing their liquidity and capital. The goal? To strengthen their balance sheets, boost cash flows, and transition out of survival mode.

What You'll Do

Rapid Value & Cash (RVC) by BCG is a new enterprise within BCG. It is a natural extension of BCG Transform Practice Area but is designed to unlock untapped transformation opportunities with greater speed, flexibility, and lower setup risk.

RVC teams work side-by-side with clients to rapidly diagnose issues and implement solutions across finance, HR, operations, supply chain, and technology. By embedding experienced operators and leveraging GenAI and forward-deployed engineers, we help organizations free up cash, optimize cost structures, and strengthen performance at pace – delivering results in weeks, not months, and enabling teams to stay focused on the most critical value drivers.

As a Senior Operator in RVC, you will take on a hands-on execution role in high-stakes transformation and performance improvement situations. Depending on project mix, this may include stepping into interim leadership positions (CxO-1 / CxO-2) within client organizations, with clear accountability for on-site results.

You will operate at the intersection of strategy and execution, taking ownership of outcomes, driving decisions, and delivering rapid, measurable impact in execution-first environments.

  

* Lead high-impact workstreams and programs in turnaround, restructuring, and value creation – from diagnosis through implementation

* At times, take end-to-end ownership of results, including P&L impact, cash delivery, and operational performance improvements – in an interim leadership capacity within client organizations
* Translate analyses into pragmatic action plans and drive execution on-site to deliver measurable business impact at pace
* Execute across key value levers (cost, cash, operations, organization), with a strong focus on speed and impact
* Partner with senior stakeholders (CEO, CFO, functional leaders) to shape decisions, drive alignment, and navigate complex transformation settings
* Embed within client organizations and mobilize BCG’s full ecosystem (experts, proprietary tools, AI-enabled capabilities) to deliver end-to-end impact
* Build trusted client relationships, identify additional value creation opportunities, and support business development efforts
* Coach and develop team members and help build sustainable capabilities within client organizations
* Contribute to the evolution of RVC methodologies, playbooks, and best practices

What You'll Bring

* 7-10 years of relevant experience in consulting, private equity value creation, restructuring, or senior industry roles, with a strong track record in transformation and performance improvement
* Experience in interim or operational leadership roles with hands-on accountability is a plus; above all, a strong track record of owning outcomes and driving measurable results
* Deep functional and/or industry expertise (e.g., operations, finance, treasury, PMO, people, or organizational transformation), with the ability to apply it in complex, real-world settings
* Proven experience delivering turnarounds, restructuring programs, or large-scale value creation initiatives with measurable impact
* Strong execution mindset with the ability to move from analysis to action – bringing a hands-on, pragmatic, and results-oriented approach
* Credibility and presence to influence senior stakeholders (CEO, CFO, functional leaders) in demanding, fast-paced environments
* Experience in private equity-backed businesses, mid-cap companies, or industrial environments; interim or on-the-ground leadership experience is a plus
* Commercial acumen and relationship-building skills, with the ability to identify opportunities and contribute to client development
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with sound judgment to balance strategic perspective and practical execution
* Demonstrated leadership and team development skills, with a commitment to coaching and capability building

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

job.title: Climate Strategy Expert / Project Manager @ Greenly (Paris, A8, FR)
job.description:
### **About us**

Greenly was founded in 2019 by Alexis, Matthieu and Arnaud with one mission: **make carbon management as essential as financial management**. In 2026, Greenly joined forces with the Nordic-founded company Normative.

Today, we are a **global leader in carbon accounting**, proudly B-Corp certified and part of the French Tech 120. Our climate suite combines smart data collection with intuitive automation, helping companies measure, reduce, and report their emissions with ease — supported at every step by our in-house climate experts.

More than **4,000 companies in 30+ countries** use Greenly to manage their climate strategy: from carbon assessments and life-cycle analyses to SBTi trajectories and compliance with CSRD and CBAM.

We are now a team of **200+ people from 40+ nationalities**, based in Paris, London, Barcelona, and New York.

To date, we’ve tracked over 200 million tons of CO₂ through our platform. Our next milestone: 10,000 clients and **one billion tons of CO2 under management**.

### **Our Values**

* Ambition for climate: Minimize GHG emissions, maximize climate impact
* Deliver with agility: Work in small increments: fail fast, learn fast, win fast
* Own your opportunities: Achieve outstanding results by showing initiative and accountability
* Feedback paves the way: Succeed as a team by helping others progress
* Be one Team: Everyone is included and needed - work together with transparency and respect

Curious to know more ? Check out our Culture Book, blog , and youtube channel

### **About the team**

You'll join Greenly's **Scale team**, within our Climate Delivery organization — the team that makes Greenly's climate expertise efficient and accessible for all of our customers. We guide SMB & mid-market customers through their most strategic climate and sustainability challenges.

As a **Climate Strategy Expert** in the Scale team, our mission is simple: *be the expert voice that makes ESG assessments rigorous, simple, and scalable.* Concretely, we deliver high-quality climate projects — carbon assessments, life-cycle analyses (LCA), SBTi trajectories, CSRD support — and we also turn that expertise into clear playbooks and product improvements so the whole team can scale without losing quality. ️

As a team, we:

* Combine analytical rigor with a strong customer success mindset
* Act as trusted advisors, not just technical analysts
* Thrive in a fast-moving, collaborative environment, sharing methods, scripts, and lessons learned
* Work closely with Customer Support, Customer Success Managers, Product, Sales, and Marketing to ensure our clients succeed and our methodologies stay robust

It's one of Greenly's most influential client-facing teams: high expectations, high volume, and real impact on both client outcomes and product evolution.

### **About the role**

Our Scale team is searching for a mission-driven Climate Strategy Expert who's passionate about supporting our customers with climate advisory while owning their post-sale experience. You'll combine hands-on delivery of climate expertise with account ownership — and, as you grow in the role, you'll also help turn recurring technical questions into playbooks and product feedback that make the whole team more efficient and our delivery more scalable. You'll be a key player in turning climate ambition into action, one customer at a time.

#### **What you will do**

* You are the trusted person for our customers, with whom you'll build long-term relationships
* You understand the customers' carbon footprints and are a thought leader that educates them on carbon measurement, target setting, carbon reduction, and carbon investments. You guide their path towards a net-zero future.
* You are the voice of our customers; the connection between them and our product, where you help shape the future in a fast-changing industry.
* You help our customers understand and navigate our product; you onboard them on the platform and drive interest for additional product and service offerings. This will accelerate their journey towards net-zero carbon emissions.
* You are proactive in customer initiatives leading to high satisfaction, retention and growth.
* You identify upsell and expansion opportunities in your book of business.
* You contribute to building clear rules, playbooks and cheat sheets so the wider team can handle recurring topics independently.
* You flag recurring technical pain points to Product, helping turn manual work into platform features.

### **Skills to succeed**

* **2–4 years of experience** in customer success, climate consulting, ESG strategy, or account management, with at least one year of experience in carbon accounting.
* Understanding of **corporate sustainability and climate frameworks** (e.g. SBTi, GHG Protocol).
* **Strong communication skills** and a collaborative mindset.
* **Educational background** within the sustainability or environmental field.
* **Ability to translate complex technical findings** into simple, actionable guidance for both clients and internal teams.
* Comfort balancing hands-on client delivery with process-improvement or standardization projects. ️
* **Drive to learn and grow** with a fast-moving mission-led team. ️
* **Full fluency in English** is required.

#### **Nice to have**

* Comfortable managing **US-based customers** (time zones, communication style, business culture)
* **Spanish-fluency** is a plus
* French is not mandatory if you speak another relevant language such as Spanish or Italian

#### **Bonus qualities that will make you shine**

We're looking for someone who will not just fit in, but help us level up. Here's what stands out:

* **Systems Thinker** ️: You can connect the dots between policy, data, and business goals. Show us in the interview how you'd advise a fictional B2B company on setting a climate target.
* **Curious & Coachable** : You actively seek feedback and apply it fast. In the interview, be ready to reflect on a learning moment that changed how you work.
* **Mission-Driven Communicator** : You can talk to sustainability leaders and procurement pros alike. Expect a roleplay task to test how you adapt messaging.
* **Proactive Collaborator** : You spot opportunities to improve team workflows or customer processes. Bring a story where you took initiative without being asked.
* **Pipeline-Minded Operator** : You're comfortable managing a sizeable portfolio of clients in parallel while keeping an eye on industrialization — turning what you learn across your pipeline into reusable playbooks and process or product improvements, rather than treating every deal as a one-off. Bring an example of how you balanced volume with continuous improvement.
